# infisical_app_connection_azure_blob_storage (Resource)

Create and manage Azure Blob Storage App Connection

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_app_connection_azure_blob_storage" "client_secret" {
  name   = "pam-recordings-azure"
  method = "client-secret"
  credentials = {
    account_name  = "acmepamrecordings"
    tenant_id     = "<azure-tenant-id>"
    client_id     = "<azure-client-id>"
    client_secret = "<azure-client-secret>"
  }
  description = "Stores PAM session recordings in Azure Blob Storage"
}

resource "infisical_app_connection_azure_blob_storage" "access_key" {
  name   = "pam-recordings-azure-key"
  method = "access-key"
  credentials = {
    account_name = "acmepamrecordings"
    account_key  = "<storage-account-key>"
  }
}

resource "infisical_pam_account_template" "windows" {
  name         = "windows-azure-recordings"
  account_type = "windows"

  settings = {
    recording = {
      storage_backend = "azure-blob"
      connection_id   = infisical_app_connection_azure_blob_storage.client_secret.id
      azure_blob = {
        container  = "pam-recordings"
        key_prefix = "windows/"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials` (Attributes) The credentials for the Azure Blob Storage App Connection (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `method` (String) The method used to authenticate with Azure Blob Storage. Possible values are: client-secret, access-key
- `name` (String) The name of the Azure Blob Storage App Connection to create. Must be slug-friendly

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description for the Azure Blob Storage App Connection.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project to scope the app connection to. If not provided, the app connection will be scoped to the organization.

### Read-Only

- `credentials_hash` (String) The hash of the Azure Blob Storage App Connection credentials
- `id` (String) The ID of the app connection

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `account_name` (String) The name of the Azure storage account. For more details, refer to the documentation here infisical.com/docs/integrations/app-connections/azure-blob-storage

Optional:

- `account_key` (String, Sensitive) An access key of the storage account. Required for the access-key method.
- `client_id` (String, Sensitive) The client ID of the Microsoft Entra app registration. Required for the client-secret method.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The client secret of the Microsoft Entra app registration. Required for the client-secret method.
- `tenant_id` (String) The Microsoft Entra tenant ID of the app registration. Required for the client-secret method.
